name: finance-capture-outage.txt
description: Runbook for card capture failures during issuer or acquirer outages.
content: When a card capture cannot reach the payment network, retain the authorization and enqueue the capture for retry after the provider health check recovers.

name: finance-duplicate-invoice.txt
content: Investigate duplicate invoice reports by comparing invoice identifiers, settlement references, and invoice creation timestamps before issuing a credit.

name: finance-capture-legacy.txt
content: For the retired gateway, staff manually resubmit card captures at the end of each day.

name: web-certificate-rotation.txt
description: Procedure for rotating a public HTTPS certificate.
content: Create a certificate signing request, obtain the replacement certificate, install the full chain, and verify the renewal monitor.

name: web-deployment-rollback.txt
description: Rollback procedure after a faulty web deployment.
content: If a deployment raises the web error rate, freeze further releases, collect the deployment identifier, and roll back to the last healthy release.

name: identity-mfa-recovery.txt
description: Account recovery for a lost multi-factor device.
content: After verifying identity through the approved recovery channel, remove the lost authenticator and require enrollment of a new factor at the next sign-in.

name: people-leave-carryover.txt
content: Employees may move up to three unused leave days into the next calendar year with manager approval. Carried days expire on 31 March.

name: shipping-missing-parcel.txt
description: Investigation steps for a shipment not delivered to a customer.
content: For a parcel reported missing, verify the tracking scan history, delivery address, proof of delivery, and carrier exception status before opening a claim.

name: data-access-log-retention.txt
description: Data retention policy for access logs.
content: Retain application access logs for ninety days, then delete them unless a legal hold is active.

name: edge-router-restart.txt
content: When the edge router stops forwarding traffic, collect diagnostic logs and then restart the router once.

name: edge-router-failover.txt
content: When the edge router stops forwarding traffic, never restart it; divert traffic to the standby router and escalate to network operations.
